lead.hed: USNI: Lincoln left 5th Fleet. A 7th Fleet box is not a homecoming.
lead.insight: USNI Saturday: Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) left the Middle East after almost seven months and is in U.S. 7th Fleet. As of Saturday, Lincoln, escorts, and Carrier Air Wing 9 were in the Indian Ocean under INDOPACOM. A transit is not San Diego. Seven months is not a rebuilt rotation.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo · DVIDS 9872030 · PUBLIC DOMAIN · An F/A-18E Super Hornet from VFA-14 launches from USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN 72), Aug. 11, 2026. Caption must say Aug. 11 flight ops, not today’s 7th Fleet box.
lead.image_note: Official U.S. Navy DVIDS still of an F/A-18E launching from Abraham Lincoln, Aug. 11, 2026, 5th Fleet. Same-subject class as the Saturday Lincoln file — not a homecoming photo, not this morning’s Hormuz Arabian Sea formation, not a brand tile.

political.hed: USNI: two mariners dead in Hormuz. A casualty count is not an open strait.
political.insight: USNI overnight, retired from the Saturday AM lead: two mariners were killed in the past week and a half in the Strait of Hormuz by Iranian attacks. Monday’s hit on MV Minoan Dignity left one seafarer dead. Transits ticked up. Two dead is not a cleared lane. Lincoln leaving is not a restored corridor.

political.hed: Heritage: tariff the Chinese cargo ship. A levy is not a yard-sale tax.
political.insight: Heritage, Friday: the administration is adapting tariffs to spare household budgets — hit the Chinese cargo ship, not the American consignment shop. A commentary is not a customs rule. Affordability talk is not a signed annex.

tech.hed: Defense News: India asked into France’s sixth-gen jet. Talks are not a workshare.
tech.insight: Defense News, Friday 12:52: India’s Defense Ministry told parliament it has “initiated efforts in a concerted manner to co-join” France’s Future Combat Air System after Paris and Berlin dropped their joint fighter. Talks are not IP. A mock-up is not a jet.

tech.hed: Defense News: Navy wants a next-gen SeaSparrow. A notice is not a missile.
tech.insight: Defense News, Thursday: the Navy is leading a 12-nation NSPO hunt for a new Evolved SeaSparrow variant — ≤10-inch, Mark 41 fit, against salvos and jamming. Sources Sought closes Oct. 19. Raytheon doubled Block II production in 2025. A graphic is not a contract. A seek is not inventory.

tech.hed: USNI Pulse: North Korea lofted about 10 SRBMs. A count is not a campaign.
tech.insight: USNI Friday Western Pacific Pulse: North Korea launched about 10 short-range ballistic missiles toward the Sea of Japan Thursday at 5 p.m., South Korea’s Joint Chiefs said. A weekly pulse is not a Pentagon confirm. Ten launches are not a new war.

culture.hed: WORLD: Smith’s luminous dark. Mystical unknowing is not the gospel.
culture.insight: WORLD, Thursday: James K.A. Smith’s new Yale book asks readers to dwell in mystical non-knowing after a midlife crisis. The review’s point: union with God is through the knowable Mediator, not a cloud that erases revelation. A mood is not a creed. Certainty about Christ is not pride.

watch.hed: WATCH: Northern Viking is still underway. An opening ceremony is not today’s lead.
watch.insight: USNI Thursday file, Friday PM lead, still Watch Saturday PM: U.S., Iceland, and NATO began biennial Northern Viking 2026 on Tuesday; it runs through Sept. 3. Seventy-fifth year of the 1951 defense agreement. A kickoff is not a GIUK garrison. The Saturday PM clock is Lincoln.
